description: This file defines the class 'SugarRelationshipFactory' which is responsible for creating and managing relationship objects within the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, caching, and rebuilding relationship definitions, and references other relationship-related classes.

classes.name: SugarRelationshipFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating, caching, and managing relationship objects based on relationship definitions. Implements singleton pattern and handles relationship cache management.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the factory.

methods.name: rebuildCache
methods.description: Rebuilds the relationship cache by regenerating the cache file.

methods.name: deleteCache
methods.description: Deletes the existing relationship cache file.

methods.name: getRelationship
methods.description: Retrieves a specific relationship object based on its name.

methods.name: getRelationshipDef
methods.description: Returns the raw relationship definition array for a given relationship name.

methods.name: loadRelationships
methods.description: Loads relationships from cache or rebuilds cache if cache file is missing.

methods.name: buildRelationshipCache
methods.description: Builds and caches all relationship definitions from the module vardefs and dictionary.

methods.name: getCacheFile
methods.description: Returns the path to the cached relationships PHP file.
